semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Masterflex SE provides specialized hoses and connection systems that are crucial for the safe transport and extraction of materials in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Masterflex SE develops and manufactures high-performance hoses and connection systems tailored for industrial applications, including the semiconductor sector. Their products are designed to safely transport or extract solid and gaseous substances, meeting specific technical requirements and regulations. They also offer engineering services for customized solutions with integrated life-cycle tracking.
